nodes.label: g-C3N4 reflections near 13 deg = in-plane tri-s-triazine packing (100); near 27.4 deg = interlayer stacking (002)
FTIR 1200-1650 cm-1 bands = CN heterocycle stretches; 810 cm-1 = triazine ring breathing; 3000-3400 cm-1 = N-H/O-H
N 1s 398.8 eV = sp2 C=N-C, 400.1 eV = N-(C)3, 401.2 eV = C-N-H, ~404.8 eV = pi excitation
Lower steady-state PL intensity means less radiative electron-hole recombination, i.e. better separation
A smaller Nyquist arc radius means lower charge-transfer resistance
Tauc relation: (alpha h nu)^(1/2) vs h nu extrapolated to zero gives the (indirect) optical gap
Type IV isotherm with H3 hysteresis indicates mesopores (slit-shaped, from plate aggregates)
Exfoliated g-C3N4 nanosheets in earlier work show more active sites and shorter carrier migration paths than bulk

notes: Spine: need -> hypothesis -> BCN base + ultrasonic exfoliation route -> exfoliation -> few-layer porous nanosheets -> SSA/mesopore volume up; branch A bandgap narrowing -> stronger absorption; branch B faster carrier separation; SSA, absorption and separation jointly -> 3.3x H2 evolution (MEC more carriers reach surface sites, argued) -> conclusion. Side: retained XRD phase, FTIR/XPS bonding, XPS composition, EPR radicals (CNS only, no BCN control). Audit a1: XRD (002) of CNS not weakened or broadened, which qualifies the few-layer claim (a.u. offset traces). Packet issues: F2 offered no panels though it has four clear panels (a-d); crop caption spans for F1a, F1b, F4a, F5a are misaligned; F3b OCR letter q; F5 caption garbled (ig.5, espectively); F2b x-axis mislabelled Wavelength (cm-1); linked text C1s assignment reversed; PL CNS maximum ~510 nm on the figure vs 497 nm in text. BCN synthesis and exfoliation conditions not in packet.
